title: Two-degree coherent structure model for a proper flat curve family
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper flat morphism of finite presentation of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every $s\in S$ write $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-base-change, def-weil-residue-field]. Assume $\dim(X_s)\leq1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] and that the structural map $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ is bijective [pqf-def-cohomology]. Put $K=Rf_*(\mathcal O_X[0])$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let $u:\mathcal O_S[0]\to K$ be the derived structural unit, whose map on degree-zero cohomology is the structural function pullback. Then $K$ is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], $H^0(u):\mathcal O_S\to H^0(K)$ is invertible, and $E=H^1(K)$ is quasi-coherent and finite locally free [pqf-def-coherent, def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Zariski-locally on $S$ there is an isomorphism
$$K\cong\mathcal O_S[0]\oplus E[-1],$$
where $E[-1]$ places $E$ in cohomological degree one. In particular $H^i(K)=0$ for $i\notin\{0,1\}$. For every morphism $g:T\to S$, put $X_T=X\times_ST$ and let $f_T:X_T\to T$ be the projection. The canonical derived module base-change map [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]
$$\delta_g:Lg^*K\longrightarrow Rf_{T,*}(\mathcal O_{X_T}[0])$$
is an isomorphism; no flatness of $g$, reducedness of $S$, or constancy of the local rank of $E$ on all of $S$ is assumed.
